name: 13152 · Skaneateles, NY
findings: ZIP 13152 (Skaneateles) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13152 (Skaneateles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13152 (Skaneateles) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).
